extensionDescription.message: Fetch and evaluate YouTube Live chat and locally hide or unhide authors per stream.

popupNotice.message: Hide comments from authors judged malicious, per stream and only on your screen.

popupPersistence.message: Hiding continues after collection stops. Unhide authors from the chat screen. This does not ban anyone or delete comments on YouTube.

selectTab.message: Click the extension icon on a YouTube watch tab.

targetFailed.message: Could not verify the target video. Select it again from the watch tab.

tabFailed.message: Could not get the watch tab. Open the extension again using its icon.

settingsNotice.message: Configured indicates whether an API key is saved. Saving alone does not check connection or authentication and does not guarantee that the key works.

localStorageNotice.message: API keys, settings and hidden author IDs are saved in this browser environment. They are not synced to other devices. They cannot be protected from people who can access your device or browser data.

youtubeCost.message: Start collection connects to YouTube. You are responsible for YouTube API quota usage.

jevCost.message: Enabling Jev evaluation sends collected comment text and posting times to Jev. You are responsible for Jev usage charges.

hidingNotice.message: Hiding applies per stream, only on your screen. It continues after stopping and can be undone from the chat screen list. This does not ban anyone or delete comments on YouTube.

credentialFailure.message: Could not configure the API key. Try again. To save, enter the key again.

keySaved.message: API key save completed. Validity has not been checked.

jevHelp.message: Used for AI evaluation of comments when you enable Jev evaluation on the chat screen.

youtubeHelp.message: Used to collect live chat when you press Start collection.

confirmationExplanation.message: This extension uses YouTube API Services and users are bound by the YouTube Terms of Service. Agree to the draft terms of use, draft privacy policy and data handling before starting collection or evaluation. Keys can be saved before agreement. Ordinary browsing of YouTube pages is outside this scope.

sendingDisclosure.message: Jev evaluation sends data to TypeSafe AI to assess maliciousness: the target comment's text and posting time, plus collected comments from the same author within 60 seconds (up to 20 including the target). Text may contain personal information. You are responsible for YouTube API quota usage and Jev charges. Jev evaluation still requires explicit enabling after agreement.

draftLimits.message: This is confirmation and agreement for a development version. The terms of use and privacy policy are drafts (effective date undecided). It does not mean formal implementation, general distribution or provider approval. Your agreement is not the comment author's consent. Conditions for transmitting third-party posts and compliance with provider terms remain unverified.

agreementPersistence.message: Only the version of the explanation you agreed to is saved locally in this Chrome profile. It is not synced to other devices and persists after restart. Agree again if the explanation version changes or saved data is lost or unreadable. No external transmission occurs without agreement. After a save error, agree again without resuming collection or evaluation. The state after restarting with faulty storage cannot be guaranteed.

agreementCheckbox.message: I agree to the terms of use (draft) and privacy policy (draft), and have read the explanation of data transmission and costs

agreed.message: Agreed (explanation version $1). Collection and Jev evaluation do not start automatically.

confirmationRequired.message: In settings, agree to the draft terms of use, draft privacy policy and data handling. No external transmission occurs until you agree.

agreementFailure.message: Could not save or retrieve agreement status. No external transmission will occur. Please agree again.

clearTitle.message: Delete hidden data for all streams

clearNote.message: Delete hidden author IDs, saved names, unhide generation data and empty saved entries for all streams from this browser.

clearQuestion.message: Delete hidden data for all streams?

clearExplanation.message: Stop collection and evaluation and unhide everyone in all streams. Delete author IDs, saved names, unhide generation data and empty saved entries. Keep API keys, settings such as the evaluation threshold, and API waiting deadlines. This does not delete YouTube posts or information already sent to Google or TypeSafe. This cannot be undone. If you explicitly resume collection and evaluation later, new evaluations may hide authors again.

cleared.message: Deleted hidden data for all streams. API keys and the evaluation threshold are retained. Resume from the chat screen.

clearFailure.message: Could not confirm deletion. Some data may remain. Collection and evaluation are stopped. Try deleting again.

filterHelp.message: High hides more readily; Low is more cautious. A comment is judged malicious if any of the seven scores meets or exceeds the evaluation threshold.

filterApplies.message: Applies to evaluations started after saving. Does not change in-progress or past results or existing hidden authors.

filterNoResend.message: Changing settings alone never resends comments or makes additional Jev requests.

thresholdRange.message: Enter a number from 0 to 1 inclusive. Smaller values hide more readily.

thresholdRangeShort.message: Enter a number from 0 to 1 inclusive.

thresholdExtremes.message: At 0, every evaluated comment is judged malicious. At 1, only categories scoring 1 qualify.

thresholdBurst.message: Ten or more posts by the same author within 10 seconds qualify for hiding regardless of this value. The context of up to 20 comments from the same author within the last 60 seconds also remains unchanged.

filterRetryInitial.message: Reopen this screen or save again.

filterFailure.message: Could not process filter settings. Saved state could not be verified. $1 Check code: $2

thresholdInvalid.message: Enter an evaluation threshold from 0 to 1 inclusive. Not saved.

monitorContinue.message: Collection continues while this screen is open, including while you watch YouTube. Collection may slow down when this screen is behind another tab or window.

monitorClose.message: Closing this screen stops collection and evaluation. Existing hidden authors remain hidden. Use the list above to unhide them.

monitorLiveOnly.message: Only live streams are supported, not chat replay for ended streams. The first request may not retrieve all past comments.

visibleLimit.message: Shows the most recent $1 comments. Authors are matched by author ID.

scoreNote.message: The evaluation score is the highest of seven scores (two decimal places). It is not a guarantee of accuracy.

scoreRawNote.message: Category scores shows unrounded values, which are also used for evaluation.

unjudgedNote.message: When processing cannot keep up or comments are old, processing may end without evaluation. Not evaluated does not mean No match.

collection_ended.message: The live stream or chat has ended.

collectionOverflow.message: Collection stopped because there are too many comments. Unprocessed comments are not evaluated. Press Start collection after 60 seconds.

clearJevStop.message: Jev evaluation stopped to delete hidden data. Resume explicitly.

clearCollectionStop.message: Collection and evaluation stopped to delete hidden data. Press Start collection to resume.

agreementChanged.message: Stopped because agreement status changed. Check agreement in settings and resume explicitly.

youtubeKeyJevStop.message: Jev evaluation also stopped because the YouTube key changed.

youtubeKeyChanged.message: Stopped because the YouTube API key changed. Press Start collection to resume.

youtubeKeyMissingStop.message: Stopped because the YouTube API key is not configured. Save it in settings.

targetChanged.message: The watch tab changed or closed. Select the video again from the extension popup on a YouTube watch tab.

jevKeyChanged.message: Evaluation stopped because the Jev API key changed or was deleted. Check settings and press Enable / resume Jev evaluation.

youtubeKeyMissing.message: YouTube API key is not configured. Save it in settings.

selectVideo.message: Select a target video from the extension popup on a YouTube watch tab.

youtube_notLive.message: This video is not live. Select a live stream.

youtube_chatDisabled.message: No live chat is available. Select another stream.

youtube_ended.message: The live stream or chat has ended. Select another stream.

youtube_notFound.message: Video or chat not found. Select it again from the watch tab.

youtube_quota.message: YouTube API quota reached. Check your quota and resume collection after it recovers.

youtube_auth.message: Check your YouTube API key and API settings.

youtube_forbidden.message: Cannot collect this chat. Select the target again from the watch tab.

youtube_network.message: Could not connect to YouTube. Check your connection and resume collection later.

youtube_rateLimited.message: Collection rate limit reached. Resume later.

youtube_unavailable.message: YouTube is temporarily unavailable. Resume collection later.

youtube_invalidResponse.message: Stopped collection because YouTube data could not be verified. Resume collection later.

youtube_invalidInput.message: Could not verify the target video or collection settings. Select the target again from the watch tab.

youtube_api.message: Could not collect comments from YouTube. Resume collection later.

hiddenStorage.message: Hidden authors and retrieved names are saved per stream in this browser. Stopping, deleting API keys or restarting the browser does not unhide them.

unhideNote.message: Unhide author displays that author's existing and new comments again. Changes may take time to appear.

unhideRejudge.message: Results from before unhiding do not hide the author again. However, newly collected comments judged malicious after unhiding can hide the author again.

noHiddenAuthors.message: No hidden authors in this stream.

hiddenListFailure.message: Could not verify the hidden list. Select the target stream again.

unhideTargetFailure.message: Could not unhide. Check the target stream.

unhideFailure.message: Could not unhide. Press Unhide author again.

jev_missingKey.message: Save a Jev API key in settings.

jev_auth.message: Jev API key authentication failed. Check the key in settings and save it again.

jev_definition.message: Could not load the Jev evaluation definition. Check the definition file, then press the resume button.

jev_validation.message: Could not request Jev evaluation. Resume later; if the issue persists, check for an extension update.

jev_rateLimited.message: Jev usage limit reached. Press resume later.

jev_overloaded.message: Jev is busy. Press resume later.

jev_network.message: Could not connect to Jev. Check your connection and press resume.

jev_invalidResponse.message: Could not verify Jev results. Press resume later.

jev_api.message: Jev evaluation failed. Press resume later.

jevDisclosure.message: Enabling Jev evaluation sends comment text and posting times to TypeSafe AI to assess maliciousness: up to 20 comments from the same author within 60 seconds, including the target. You are responsible for usage charges.

jevAgreement.message: Nothing is sent before you agree to the draft terms of use, draft privacy policy and data handling in settings. Your agreement is not the comment author's consent.

jevScope.message: Only comments collected after enabling are evaluated. Only text and posting times from the same author's last 60 seconds are sent (up to 20 including the target). Author IDs, other authors' comments and API keys are not included in post data.

jevSingleRequest.message: Each comment is evaluated for seven categories in one request. Failed requests are not automatically resent.

jevHiding.message: Authors judged malicious are hidden only on your screen for this stream. This does not ban anyone or delete comments on YouTube.

burstDisclosure.message: This extension detects ten or more posts by the same author within 10 seconds using the retrieved posting times.

jevNotEnabled.message: Jev not enabled: no external transmission.

unjudgedLimit.message: Not evaluated: waiting time or visible comment limit exceeded.

jevStopped.message: Jev evaluation stopped. Press Enable / resume Jev evaluation to resume.

jevEnabled.message: Jev evaluation enabled. New comments are evaluated in order.

evaluationStopped.message: $1 Evaluation is stopped. It will not resume automatically.

unjudgedMissing.message: Not evaluated: required comments unavailable or evaluation interrupted.

burstUnavailable.message: / Burst detection unavailable: posting time could not be verified

jevDisabledResult.message: / Jev evaluation not started or stopped

unjudgedQueueFull.message: Not evaluated: too many comments; waiting limit exceeded.

queueFull.message: Too many comments to evaluate all of them. Not evaluated does not mean No match.

category_attack.message: Attacks, insults or denigration of a person

category_hate.message: Discrimination or hatred based on personal attributes

category_doxxing.message: Exposure of another person's private personal information

category_spam.message: Spam such as unwanted repetition or bulk posting

termsDraft.message: Effective date: undecided. This document is a draft for confirmation and agreement in the development version, not formally in effect. It does not mean general distribution or provider approval of this use.

termsAbout.message: Agent Moderator is a Chrome extension developed independently by an individual developer in their private time. It is not an official extension of Google, YouTube or TypeSafe.

termsFunction.message: It collects and displays chat from a YouTube live stream selected by the user. Optional Jev evaluation and local burst detection hide the relevant author's comments only on the user's own screen. It does not ban anyone or delete posts on YouTube, or change other viewers' screens. For evaluation categories, thresholds and operating details, see $1.

termsAgreement.message: Read the draft terms of use, $1 and the transmission and cost explanations in settings. If you agree, check the box and press Save agreement. This agreement is to a development-version draft and is separate from formal implementation or approval for publication. Installing, reading documents or saving keys alone is not treated as agreement.

termsGate.message: Until you agree, YouTube API collection and transmission to Jev cannot start. Saving agreement alone does not automatically start collection or evaluation; Jev requires separate explicit enabling. Ordinary browsing of YouTube pages is outside this agreement's scope.

termsYoutube.message: This extension uses YouTube API Services. By using this extension, users are bound by the $1. For Google's handling of information, see the $2.

termsCosts.message: Currently, users configure their own YouTube and Jev API keys. Users are responsible for YouTube API quota usage and Jev usage charges. Check provider contracts, pricing and quotas. Saving a key does not verify successful connection, authentication or available quota.

termsProviders.message: Jev is subject to TypeSafe's $1 and $2, as well as the user's individual contracts and settings. Agreement to this extension alone does not satisfy external services' conditions of use.

termsSending.message: After collection starts, API keys and target stream information are sent to Google to retrieve chat. If Jev is explicitly enabled, the target comment's text and posting time, along with recently collected comments from the same author, are sent to TypeSafe AI to assess maliciousness. See the privacy policy for the precise transmission scope, authentication, storage and processing by external services.

termsPersonalData.message: Comment text may contain personal information. Text is not automatically anonymized. The user's agreement is not the comment author's consent and does not replace third-party rights or required notices or consent. Conditions for transmitting third-party posts and the suitability of this use under providers' terms are under review.

termsLimitations.message: Incorrect judgments, missed content, collection or communication failures and display delays may occur. Evaluations do not establish an author's character or legal unlawfulness. Hidden authors can be checked and unhidden from the list. Evaluation accuracy, speed and other behavior with the real APIs remain unverified.

termsStopping.message: Stop Jev evaluation stops transmission to Jev; Stop collection stops collection and evaluation. Stopping alone does not delete saved hidden-author data, and hiding remains in effect.

termsDeletion.message: Use Unhide author to unhide individual authors from the target stream's list. Delete hidden data for all streams deletes hidden IDs, names and unhide generation data, but retains settings such as API keys. Deleting a key in settings is separate from revoking keys or canceling contracts with providers.

termsUninstall.message: Uninstalling the extension can delete its local storage. These actions cannot delete YouTube posts or information already sent to external services. See the privacy policy for retention scope and deletion procedures.

termsProhibited.message: Do not use the extension in violation of laws or third-party rights, misuse someone else's API keys, circumvent providers' usage limits, or use it to attack or harass third parties. Respect external service conditions and third-party rights.

termsContact.message: For questions about operation, privacy or deletion, contact $1. Do not send API keys, unnecessary real chat text or other people's personal information. The privacy policy describes how inquiry information is handled.

termsReagreement.message: When explanations covered by the agreement change, the version will be updated and renewed agreement requested in settings. Previous confirmation or agreement will not automatically migrate to a new version. Renewed agreement is also required if saved data is lost or unreadable. Publication of documents or continued use alone is not treated as agreement.
